en: Black-and-white vintage street scene showing a long straight city street lined with multi‑story buildings. People walk and stand in the roadway, with early 20th‑century clothing visible. Overhead wires and telegraph poles line the street. On the prominent corner building to the right is a shop sign reading "AGNES BACHMAN". At the top of the image is printed the caption "Uddevalla. Kungsgatan." indicating the location.
